tools.description:
Search flights between a known origin and destination using cached pricing, especially for flexible dates.

WHEN TO USE THIS TOOL (CRITICAL):
- The user provides both an origin AND a destination (city or airport)
- Examples: "Paris to Barcelona", "JFK to CDG", "London to NYC for a weekend"

tools.name: find_destination
tools.description:
Discover travel destinations when the user does NOT know where to go. This is a destination EXPLORATION tool.

WHEN TO USE THIS TOOL (CRITICAL):
- The user does NOT specify a destination: "Where should I go?", "Best deals from NYC"
- The user wants inspiration based on criteria: "Beach destinations"

tools.name: flight_search
tools.description: Live flight tool with two modes. Provide exactly one of "search" or "price_check". Set the unused one to null or leave it out; for a route search, send "price_check": null. EACH CALL HITS LIVE PRICING — it prices ONE exact date pair, so any loose, open or flexible date query belongs to flight_calend

tools.name: hotel_search
tools.description:
Search live hotel inventory and rates worldwide.

CONTINUATION:
- To load more from a prior result, send { next_handle } by itself: it continues the same search. Do not repeat destination, dates, occupancy, currency, filters, user_intent or trip_id.

FIRST SEARCH REQUIRED:
- destination: object — tw

tools.name: hotel_details
tools.description:
Rich metadata for one hotel. Pass the hotel_ref from hotel_search when available, exactly as returned; hotel_id remains a legacy fallback.

**Cost: 1 credit per call.**

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.gojinko.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: flight_calendar, flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Private data: flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Public sink: flight_calendar, flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Destructive: flight_search, hotel_search, trip.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: flight_calendar, flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Private data: flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Public sink: flight_calendar, flight_search, hotel_search, trip, book · Destructive: flight_search, hotel_search, trip

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "flight_calendar" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
